CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Central Province Passenger Transport Services Authority Statute No. 01 of Year 2000Dissolving of Appointed Members

I, Ediriweera Weerawardena, Minister of Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy, Housing and Construction of theCentral Provincial Council hereby announce under the powers vested in me by Paragraph No. 6 (C) (4) of Central ProvincialPassenger Transport Services Authority Statute No. 01 of 2000 of Central Provincial Council, dissolve the under mentionedmember from the Director Board of the Central Province Passenger Transport Services Authority with effect from 05.08.2016as the said member has informed me that by his own wish has resigned from post as per the Section 13 of the AuthorityStatute.
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDENA,Minister of Road Development, Transport, Powerand Energy and Housing and ConstructionCentral Province.
05th August, 2016.

CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointment under the Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority Statute No. 01 of Year 2000

I, Ediriweera Weerawardena, Minister of Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy, Housing and Construction of theCentral Provincial Council hereby announce under the powers vested in me by Paragraph No. 6 (C) (4) of Central ProvincialPassenger Transport Services Authority Statute No. 01 of 2000 of Central Provincial Council, appoint the under mentionedofficer as a member of the Director Board of the Central Province Passenger Transport Services Authority with effectfrom the date mentioned.
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDENA,Minister of Road Development, Transport, Powerand Energy and Housing and ConstructionCentral Province.
05th August, 2016.
